question: When and with what mental focus should offerings be given during recitation?
premises: Offerings are given at the beginning of recitation.
Offerings are given at the end of recitation.
The giver maintains an undivided mind always.
inference: Therefore one should always give offerings at the beginning and end of recitation with an undivided mind.
plain_english: At the beginning and end of recitation, one should always give offerings with an undivided mind.
